title: Pi Live 桥接工程化正确化
objective: 基于当前 Pi 0.75.5 源码与 PSM 真实调用链，系统修正 Pi Live/bridge 的协议、状态与 RPC 正确性，并用自动化测试和构建证据闭环。

phases.name: act on learning and hand off

decision_points.question: Which route should the next implementation take?

options.label: Direct implementation
options.criteria: Scope is clear, blast radius is small, and validation path is known.

options.label: Research first
options.criteria: Domain facts, dependencies, or ownership are still unclear.

options.label: Split into slices
options.criteria: The work is valid but too broad for one safe change.

decision_points.rationale: Pi Live 正确性跨 bridge/Pi API 与 PSM realtime/registry/frontend 两个独立文件和测试边界，按两条 slice 并行审计可降低 blast radius，并符合用户允许的 2-agent 协作约束。

decision_points.question: After Check, should this cycle close, pivot, or continue?

options.label: Close cycle
options.criteria: Acceptance evidence is complete and no important risk remains.

options.label: Continue same cycle
options.criteria: Core direction is right but more execution is required.

options.label: Pivot plan
options.criteria: Validation changed the problem or invalidated current assumptions.

decision_points.rationale: Earendil 0.85.1 API/event semantics have been personally verified; bridge, frontend and Rust regression suites plus typecheck/fmt/check/build/diff hygiene all pass; remaining warnings are pre-existing/non-blocking and no acceptance gap remains.

validation.notes: Earendil 0.85.1: bridge 8 files/33 tests passed; focused TS 3 files/18 tests passed; extension typecheck passed; Rust registry 3 tests + pi_live integration 7 tests passed; cargo fmt/check passed; pnpm build passed; stale current refs scan clean.

next_action: Cycle closed; hand off verified diff and Workhub PR change record without pushing.
notes: 目标版本已由用户修正为 @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 最新版；2026-09-10 registry latest=0.85.1。生成器创建时 objective 中的 0.75.5 为历史初始值，当前任务目标与验收以 task.md / Workhub Issue 为准。
